name: Create SCIM Group
description: Create SCIM Group Creates a new SCIM Group (user group) for the account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups
Creates a new SCIM Group (user group) for the account. The `displayName` must not be empty and must not begin with `CF` (reserved for system groups).
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete SCIM Group
description: Delete SCIM Group Deletes a SCIM Group (custom user groups only). DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups/{group_id}

name: Get SCIM Group
description: Get SCIM Group Retrieves a single SCIM Group resource by group ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups/{group_id}

name: List SCIM Groups
description: List SCIM Groups Lists SCIM Group resources for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups
Lists SCIM Group resources for the account. Returns both system groups (backed by Cloudflare permission groups, prefixed `cloudflare-v1-`) and custom user groups. Supports filtering by `displayName` using SCIM filter syntax.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: startIndex (query); count (query); filter (query)

name: Patch SCIM Group
description: Patch SCIM Group Partially updates a SCIM Group via PATCH operations (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.2). PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups/{group_id}

name: Replace SCIM Group
description: Replace SCIM Group Replaces the mutable attributes of a SCIM Group (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.1), including its complete member set. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Groups/{group_id}

name: Get SCIM Resource Type
description: Get SCIM Resource Type Returns a single SCIM resource type by ID (RFC 7643 Section 6). GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/ResourceTypes/{resource_type_id}

name: List SCIM Resource Types
description: List SCIM Resource Types Returns the list of SCIM resource types supported by the Cloudflare SCIM service (RFC 7643 Section 6, RFC 7644 Section 4). GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/ResourceTypes
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/ResourceTypes
Returns the list of SCIM resource types supported by the Cloudflare SCIM service (RFC 7643 Section 6, RFC 7644 Section 4). Clients use this to discover available resource categories (e.g. Users, Groups) and their associated schemas. Query parameters are not supported on this endpoint.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get SCIM Schema
description: Get SCIM Schema Returns a single SCIM schema definition by schema URI ID (RFC 7643 Section 7). GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Schemas/{schema_id}

name: List SCIM Schemas
description: List SCIM Schemas Returns the list of SCIM schemas supported by the Cloudflare SCIM service (RFC 7643 Section 7, RFC 7644 Section 4). GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Schemas
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Schemas
Returns the list of SCIM schemas supported by the Cloudflare SCIM service (RFC 7643 Section 7, RFC 7644 Section 4). Clients use this to introspect the attributes of each resource type. Query parameters are not supported on this endpoint.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get SCIM Service Provider Config
description: Get SCIM Service Provider Config Returns the SCIM 2.0 Service Provider configuration (RFC 7643 Section 5). GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
Returns the SCIM 2.0 Service Provider configuration (RFC 7643 Section 5). IdPs use this endpoint to auto-configure their SCIM integration with Cloudflare, discovering which optional features (patch, bulk, filter, etc.) are supported.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Create SCIM User
description: Create SCIM User Provisions a new account member via SCIM. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users
Provisions a new account member via SCIM. The `userName` field must be a valid email address and must match the primary email in `emails`. The account must be an Enterprise account with SCIM entitlements enabled.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete SCIM User
description: Delete SCIM User Deprovisions a SCIM User by removing their membership from this account (RFC 7644 Section 3.6). DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users/{user_id}

name: Get SCIM User
description: Get SCIM User Retrieves a single account member as a SCIM User resource by user tag. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users/{user_id}

name: List SCIM Users
description: List SCIM Users Lists account members as SCIM User resources. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users
Lists account members as SCIM User resources. Supports optional filtering by `userName` (email) using the SCIM filter syntax (e.g. `userName eq "user@example.com"`). Pagination is controlled via `startIndex` and `count` query parameters per RFC 7644 Section 3.4.2.4.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: startIndex (query); count (query); filter (query)

name: Patch SCIM User
description: Patch SCIM User Partially updates a SCIM User via PATCH operations (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.2). PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users/{user_id}

name: Replace SCIM User
description: Replace SCIM User Replaces a SCIM User resource (RFC 7644 Section 3.5.1). PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/scim/v2/Users/{user_id}
